summary: #487. Prior delivery checked first: NECESSARY-CONCRETE-FROM-ACTUAL-GROUNDED and NECESSARY-ROOT-CONTROLS (#553) deliver the conditional and omissions of dependence, well-foundedness and population, with relation-type, counterpart and accessibility controls; closed PR #528's branch codex/487-necessary-concrete-root was not merged and its vocabulary is superseded by Profile, so it was not revived. Its issue-comment strengthening (same witness necessary and root) is delivered here as a clause of the controls. Question: which route statement does a necessary concretum supply? Searched the paraphrases of the direct premises of the 11 root arguments: none mentions necessity or contingency, matching the blocker of ATTEMPT-WF-REVERSE-DILEMMA-553. Without bridges nothing: one model has two necessary actual roots and fails grades-have-a-maximum, something-is-moved and the first-being premise. These share no predicate with Profile, so that independence is cheap and tests only those three premises. With bridges one connection was found: via the tertia via's convergence, at modal readings of its parameters, the necessary root yields STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING. Rejected as a claim of progress: that conclusion costs seven open non-logical premises for one, so no route cost falls. Finding: with two bridges covering every actual concretum in place of NecessaryBeingHasBeing and the two necessity-cause bridges, the same premise follows from mere asymmetry of the selected relation, with no root, necessity, contingency or inhabitedness premise, and a witness has a contingent maximum. So under those stronger bridges that derivation uses neither rootness nor necessity. Rejected reading: identifying Possible with accessibility as source fidelity; it is recorded as a parameter reading. Also certified: rootness is world-relative; a begins-to-exist law does not give the closing premise over a past with no first moment. Not attempted: Pruss, Oppy and Craig witnesses listed on #487; no source claim is made. Metadata audit (2026-11-09): inspected every definition/disambiguation link on b19ffd92-01bd-5c0b-9643-e7407137ea5e against frozen BruteFoundationBoundary.NecessaryConcreteAt: ∃ x, m.concrete x ∧ m.ontic.ExistsAt w x ∧ NecessaryAt m.ontic w x. Replaced c57e2682-08e6-527e-950f-0fa0a7ff11ef (NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot) with existing 1b8baf77-84fa-5513-a138-7fa14840dd87 (CogitoConcrete.InhabitedConcreteAt). The former adds absence of actual concrete grounds, which this endpoint neither states nor consumes; Profile carrying a grounds field does not make roothood part of the proposition. The replacement defines exactly its concrete/actual witness conjuncts on the same Ontic and world; its supplied world-independent concrete predicate remains parametric, not automatically a defended esse criterion. Retained all five other links: baddf770 supplies the de-re/de-dicto quantifier distinction (this formula uses the fixed-witness de-re member of that vocabulary bundle, not its DeDicto locator as a claimed equality); e1ff44df the fixed roster, actualist existence guards and rigid identity; f8948e28 the frame/accessibility vocabulary; 38b92bb6 the exact NecessaryAt body ∀ v, access w v → ExistsAt v x; beb654a7 the Ontic signature. Retained disambiguation 7507d645: the same candidate exists actually and at all accessible worlds, not Scott essence-based NE or temporal cannot-not-be. No claim that a vocabulary container defines every component or that its unused Causes field adds causal content. No reflexivity is implicit, so an empty accessible cone leaves actual concrete existence. Existing unique-root projection explicitly forgets roothood and uniqueness; the necessary-bearer consumer drops only concreteness. Frozen Lean, statement paraphrase, all premises, source claims, allowances and proof evidence are unchanged. This is semantic metadata repair, not a new consequence, original declaration completion, premise discharge or root truth. Same-profile endpoint assembly remains separate work; no unmerged proof is imported. Validation of this metadata delta: corpus check, bundle_audit, sense/label ratchets, attribution-check and generated imports/docs pass. Explicit binding of all fourteen direct provider/consumer result IDs reports 14 bound, 0 mismatch; automatic affected selection is not relied upon as consumer coverage. Existing frozen proof/kernel/Comparator/NanoDa evidence is reused without a new proof claim; final delivered-head CI remains required. Computed frontier-diff against main 4de4ca01e10a2e6483a397eb5acab04da75d0522 reports no change (396 open reaching premises, lowest route cost 16, 284 verified support alternatives); thickness is unchanged at 575 statements, 180 derived, 53 multiply derived, 330 derivations. No independent source or metaphysical applicability check was added. Shared convention sourceRevision 625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0.
blocker: The closing premise EveryContingentGroundedAt and restricted well-foundedness have no defence for any real relation; the four bridges are open; a route premise needing de re necessity was not found, so the necessary-being milestone does not lower a route cost. Whether a route should gain a necessity-consuming premise is a modelling question for the owner, not a proof gap.
